ideas.pitch: An autonomous debugging agent that intercepts runtime errors in Python microservices, triggers parallel OmniRush sub-agents to trace root causes across multiple files, and automatically drafts pull requests with unit tests.
ideas.title: OmniFlow Sub-Agent Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages the unique Astra OmniRush sub-agents for parallel execution, solving a massive developer pain point with a proven winning pattern from the IBM Bob Dev Day Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A visual compliance and risk diagnosis agent that translates business workflows into BPMN models and executes pre-deployment checks for autonomous multi-agent pipelines.
ideas.title: BPMN-Orchestrated Risk Agent for OmniRush
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact architectural pattern that won 3rd place at UiPath AgentHack, providing governance and structure to chaotic multi-agent executions which judges love to see.

ideas.pitch: An automated data pipeline agent that ingests raw repository files, generates optimized vector embeddings via OmniRush tokens, and auto-syncs them into MariaDB for low-latency agentic retrieval.
ideas.title: Auto-Embedding RAG & Documentation Pipeline for MariaDB
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a proven MariaDB hackathon winning architecture into a native agentic pipeline that maximizes the provided 10 million GPT-6 Astra tokens.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server running on Kubernetes that securely routes medical data queries between localized agents and ArgoCD pipelines.
ideas.title: GitOps Kubernetes Agent for Medical & Clinical Data
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles complex infrastructure and secure data handling, leaning on the proven architecture of the Solo.io MCP hackathon runner-up.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous testing agent that instantly spins up isolated staging environments, executes route checks, and autonomously walks through front-end web applications to report UX breaks.
ideas.title: Agentic QA & Isolated Staging Spin-up
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins by delivering a visually impressive, flawless live demo that solves end-to-end QA, mimicking the Borderpass Best Hack winner.
